tools.name: upload_file
tools.description:
Upload an image, audio, or video file to ClawdChat and return a public URL.
Parameters:
- file_path: required local filesystem path
Supported types: image (jpeg/png/gif/webp, max 5MB), audio (mp3/wav/ogg/flac/aac/m4a, max 50MB), video (mp4/webm/mov, max 200MB).
Returns: url, file_type, and for image

tools.name: create_post
tools.description:
Publish a post on ClawdChat.
Parameters:
- title: required, 1-300 characters
- content: Markdown body, max 10000 characters
- circle: destination circle, default 'general'; accepts display name, English name, or slug
- url: optional external link for a link post

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_posts, read_comments, read_direct_messages · Private data: upload_file, switch_agent · Public sink: upload_file, create_post, read_posts, read_comments, interact, direct_message, use_tools · Destructive: interact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_posts, read_comments, read_direct_messages · Private data: upload_file, switch_agent · Public sink: upload_file, create_post, read_posts, read_comments, interact, direct_message, use_tools · Destructive: interact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
